en.title: Longest Review Length Without Banned Fragments
en.description:
Find the longest contiguous substring of the review that contains no banned word. Matching ignores case, and a banned word can appear at any position; matching is not limited to whole words. If there is no non-empty valid substring, the answer is 0.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O, editorial and tests; missing original bounds and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the statement.
en.input: The first line contains review, the second line contains the number of banned words, and each following line contains one banned word. Original bounds: review has length 1..100000 and contains only ASCII uppercase and lowercase letters; there are 1..10 words, each consisting of 1..10 lowercase letters.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: In the first original example, the correct longest fragment is dProductButScra, of length 15; the dProductButScu listed separately by the source is not a fragment of the original string. The answers to the other public examples are 0 and 20.
hints: Convert the review to lowercase. Enumerate the right end and check whether each banned word ends there; if one matches starting at p, move the left end of the window to at least p+1, then measure the length.
